description: Get the specified Data Lake Analytics firewall rule.

operations.description: Gets the specified Data Lake Analytics firewall rule.

params.description: The name of the Data Lake Analytics account.
params.name: accountName

params.description: The name of the firewall rule to retrieve.
params.name: firewallRuleName

params.description: The name of the Azure resource group.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: Get subscription credentials which uniquely identify Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.
params.name: subscriptionId

props.description: The end IP address for the firewall rule. This can be either ipv4 or ipv6. Start and End should be in the same protocol.
props.name: endIpAddress

props.description: The start IP address for the firewall rule. This can be either ipv4 or ipv6. Start and End should be in the same protocol.
props.name: startIpAddress

responses.description: Successfully retrieved the specified firewall rule.
